acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Free plan has five users, one Inbox, one Docs site and a 100-contact monthly cap. Check the official pricing page for the current details.

mainEntity.name: Can Help Scout replace a ticketing system?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can manage conversations, assignments, tags, workflows and reporting. Teams that depend on advanced ticket fields or tightly linked incident types should compare their requirements before switching.

mainEntity.name: Can I connect an AI agent to Help Scout?

acceptedAnswer.text: The official MCP connection is read-only for new connections. Standard, Plus and Pro include API access; reporting tools require Plus or Pro.
